instruction: You will start by facing a french door. Turn right and take a step inside this room. Turn left and you will see an open doorway walk towards that. Take a step on the hallway in front of you. Turn right and you will see a bedroom. Walk inside, turn right once again and take two steps towards the bathroom. Turn left and walk towards the shower and there's a doorway in front of you. Walk towards this doorway and once you're standing in front of the toilet then you're done.
